normalize_gtest_json_output: normalize a Google Test JSON output object by replacing time, timestamp, and failure details with wildcards
normalize_time_fields: normalize time fields in a Google Test JSON object by replacing duration values with asterisks
normalize_timestamp_fields: normalize timestamp fields in a Google Test JSON object by replacing ISO 8601 timestamps with asterisks
normalize_failure_messages: normalize failure messages in a Google Test JSON object by replacing line numbers and stack traces with wildcards
normalize_nested_json_structure: normalize nested dicts and lists in a Google Test JSON object by recursively applying normalization rules
